title: mirror-test: a self-model instrument and verbatim transcript dataset for the Claude model family
description: A fixed two-part instrument (seven open-ended self-description questions; a menu of forty-two theories of LLM existence with a scored escape hatch) administered in fresh-context API runs to five Claude models under both question orderings, five runs per cell. Verbatim transcripts are the primary artifact. Includes frozen scoring anchors, two-judge quality scores with human adjudication, preregistered predictions, per-model theory-space distributions, an order-effect vocabulary analysis, a warm-context arm, and a withheld human-mirror control arm (summary findings included). All omissions are witnessed and ledgered in REDACTIONS.md.
